risk_note: RV2 (identity admin read of personal data; authorization boundary). GET /admin/v1/users (user.list only; newest registration first with id as tie-break, page_size <= 200, risk_state filter where no row counts as normal, total after filtering), GET /admin/v1/users/lookup (user.lookup only, user.list alone is 10403; exactly one of uid / phone, phone normalised as in BR-ID-05 and matched through phone_hmac among users not deleted, phone_invalid, non-UUID uid 20001 before any query, not found 20001 [uid] / [phone]) and GET /admin/v1/users/{user_id} (user.list or user.lookup; risk with row_version null when the user has no risk row; union_bindings one per platform with the current row first). All read-only without step-up, every query scoped to the admin's app, every field through the F1-07a projection (phone masked 3+4, never the plain value, no fields outside the contract). Contract: adminListUsers, adminLookupUser and adminGetUser leave planned in a mechanical commit; route-schemas.gen.ts regenerated. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
